checks.name: TS/TSX: complete source syntax (not a framework typecheck)
132 original lots, unique IDs, consistent prices and referenced media
Panel and CSV reject visitors without a signed administrator session
Consent rejects cross-origin requests and sets signed HttpOnly cookie
Global Privacy Control forces marketing off
Public tracking rejects missing consent, forged conversions and forged form success
Event retries are idempotent; names, phones, passwords and URL queries are stripped
Batch/body size limits and malformed JSON are enforced
WhatsApp intention gets a stable exact R-code, attribution and timestamp, never a Lead
Intent IDs cannot be overwritten by another signed visitor
CRM refuses invalid HMAC, wrong tenant, missing identity, old timestamp and mismatched references
Confirmed first incoming message creates exactly one Lead and two provider jobs
Webhook retries and new conversions for the same contact do not increase Leads
Concurrent local confirmations deduplicate by contact atomically
Unknown valid references stay unattributed and produce no advertising jobs
Legacy code-only webhook cannot bypass canonical conversion verification
CAPI payloads use Lead with stable event ID, separate SHA256 phone, and no form text
Provider sends persist success; repeated drains do not send twice (mock providers)
CONVERSION_SENDER=crm prevents a second CAPI sender
Queue leases prevent stale workers from overriding delivery status
Provider rejection does not become a fake success and keeps the same event ID for retry
Withdrawing consent cancels pending jobs, rejects stale tracking and does not resurrect on retry
A later CRM receipt for a withdrawn visitor can be counted but never advertised
Form validation and honeypot reject malformed input without dispatch
Missing CRM destination returns 503 with no fabricated confirmation
Form still works after rejecting analytics; retries forward only once
CRM failure is 502 and a retry can subsequently complete (same submission ID)
Consented form forwards intent and attribution but records FormSubmitted, never Lead
Form idempotency rejects changed body with the same submission ID
Password hash, login, tamper protection, logout and password rotation
Authenticated panel returns real stored events without secrets or matching cookies
Date ranges use Peru business days; invalid and over-31-day ranges are rejected
CSV protects formula cells and exports only after authentication
Rate limits persist and private production never falls back to a JSON file
SQL installer denies public access, isolates site and includes unique conversion/lease controls (static review)
Browser client requires consent, names form intent as a custom event, and never emits Lead
Motion, pause, reduced-motion and consent widgets are connected to the real layout (static review)
